text: RAHUL MONDAL
Pune, India | rahulmondal01155@gmail.com | +91 9006412255 LinkedIn - LinkedIn URL
PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Markets operations professional with 3 years of experience across securities settlements, post-trade operations, exception
management, reconciliations, operational controls, and corporate action income processing within global wealth management
operations. Experienced in managing end-to-end settlement workflows across Equities, Fixed Income, Structured Products, and FX-
related processes, investigating settlement fails and cash breaks, coordinating with custodians and brokers, and working to market
deadlines and operational SLAs. Strong track record in root-cause analysis, risk mitigation, process improvement, and automation of
repetitive operational workflows using Excel-based solutions. Experienced in supporting regulatory and market-driven change,
including the US T+1 settlement transition.
CORE COMPETENCIES
Trade Lifecycle Controls | Securities Settlements | Exception & Fail Management | Cash & Position Reconciliations | Root-Cause
Analysis | Operational Risk & Controls | KPI Monitoring | Custodian & Counterparty Management | Buy-In Risk Management |
Corporate Actions | Process Automation | SWIFT Messaging | Advanced Excel | Stakeholder Management
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Security Settlement Analyst, UBS Business Solutions | Jul 2023 – Present
Risky Markets – Equity & Fixed Income / Structured Products | Mar 2025 – Present
Own daily settlement controls across multiple European and emerging markets, monitoring trade status, pre-matching exceptions,
settlement instruction mismatches, market deadlines, and aged fails to support timely settlement and reduce operational risk.
Investigate and resolve settlement exceptions involving trade economics, pricing, settlement instructions, counterparty
mismatches, and internal processing issues; perform root-cause analysis and coordinate corrective actions with internal teams and
external parties.
Perform daily cash reconciliations between internal books and custodian records, investigate breaks and missing cash flows, and
drive exceptions through timely resolution.
Monitor potential buy-in exposure and fail risk, applying market-specific timelines, notice periods, and escalation requirements to
prevent avoidable costs and client impact.
Coordinate with custodians, brokers, middle office, risk, and other stakeholders to resolve high-priority settlement issues and
improve operational outcomes.
Track operational queues and exception ageing against deadlines and SLAs, prioritizing high-value, client-critical, and market-
cutoff-sensitive items.
Fixed Income & Structured Product Settlements – Clearstream, DTC/Fed and German Market | Nov 2023 – Feb 2025
Managed end-to-end post-trade settlement workflows, including pre-matching, instruction validation, settlement monitoring, fail
investigation, exception resolution, and escalation across domestic and international markets.
Used SWIFT and market/custodian information to investigate trade and settlement discrepancies, liaising with brokers and
custodians to resolve breaks and support value-date settlement.
Investigated failed trades, identified underlying causes, coordinated remediation, and implemented preventive controls to reduce
recurring settlement issues and financial exposure.
Supported the 2024 US market transition from T+2 to T+1 by adapting operational monitoring and settlement processes to
compressed timelines and heightened exception-management requirements.
Identified repetitive manual activities and developed automation solutions for pre-matching notifications, settlement queue
monitoring, email categorization, urgent-item flagging, and turnaround-time reporting.
Improved workflow efficiency and settlement turnaround through process enhancements while maintaining records of settlements,
reconciliations, exceptions, and escalations for control and audit requirements.
Corporate Action Income Processing | Jul 2023 – Oct 2023
Created and validated corporate action income events and supported accurate processing of dividends, interest, and redemption
payments in line with market standards and internal controls.
Performed control checks over event setup and payment processing, investigated discrepancies, and used SWIFT messaging to
support timely and accurate cash-flow processing.
SELECTED PROCESS IMPROVEMENT & CHANGE EXPERIENCE
Developed automation for counterparty pre-matching outreach and settlement queue monitoring, reducing repetitive manual
activity and improving visibility of pending and urgent trades.
Built an Outlook-integrated email categorization and TAT-monitoring workflow to classify counterparty and custodian queries, flag
urgent cases, and support management reporting on response times.
Automated elements of an Israel-market capital-gains-tax cash reconciliation process, including calculation support and MT599-
related operational messaging after settlement.
Contributed to market-structure change initiatives and settlement process improvements, with practical experience adapting
controls and workflows for compressed settlement cycles.
